services.name: Own Boat
services.desc: Your Boat + Our Captain! There is no better way to enjoy your beautiful boat around Nantucket than bringing along one of our expert captains so you can actually RELAX and FISH with your family or friends. Let us handle the boat and facilitate the fishing while you enjoy yourself and your boat! LEARN! If you're looking to build you knowledge of Nantucket fishing, become more comfortable running your boat in our shallow waters, or the basics of boat handling, equipment, or electronics, The absolute best way is first hand and hands on with one of us there to help. We love sharing our fishing Hire our Captain to run your boat · $250 Hour Call to reserve

services.name: Larger Groups - Wedding, Anniversary, Birthday, Company Parties, etc.
services.desc: If you are over 6 anglers, we will accomodate your group. The max amount is 16 anglers. Although we cannot fit everyone on one boat, we spread the group out onto 2 or 3 boats depending on the number of people, and fish the boats as close to one another as we can. This allows our larger parties to still have the experience of a private charter while having a blast and making lasting memories! Call our office to book Up to 16 Anglers. Call to BOOK 508-228-4225

blurb: Capt. Tom infuses his passion for people, fishing, and Nantucket into a charter experience that stands alone. His emphasis on your enjoyment and light tackle fishing created a loyal following that continues to grow. This success allows us to run 4 boats specifically designed for fishing around Nantucket.
